root_causes: PaintImage/PaintSvg inserted tiles into the app image atlas while the present loop passes the window atlas; images failed the atlas check (needs texture 0) and SVG masks could sample the wrong texture. The pin has one sprite atlas per window (window.rs:4865 glyphs, :5009 svg, :5104 images; gpui_windows directx_renderer.rs:387, 1133-1170)

the native shaping-handle bound (256) is per process; the text element shapes twice (unwrapped + wrapped), so ~128 texts in a frame, or two frames across a page switch, hit it; a failed frame never ran finishFrame, so its lines stayed live and every later frame failed (latched)
the stop-path panic came from OpenWindowView: a failed first draw panicked inside the host's window trampoline, so Host.Stop reported it
fixes: render.go Window.spriteAtlas(): the window's own atlas (as GlyphAtlas); PaintImage and PaintSvg insert there; test windows fall back to the app atlas
dropImage removes the image from every open window's atlas, ignoring per-window results as the pin does (app.rs:2815-2825), then from the app atlas

text.go/text_cache.go: the pinned LineLayoutCache::finish_frame rotation (line_layout.rs:1008, window.rs:3230) is kept; cache-owned lines are enrolled in an LRU on TextSystem; on the native limit shapeHandle parks the oldest idle cache-owned line (keeping its summary and request) and retries; parked lines re-shape on the next query; ShapeText lines are never parked; the live count stays at or under 256 and nothing latches
view.go OpenWindowView: a failed first draw is logged and the window marked for redraw, as the frame loop treats later failed frames

files: tests: gpui/window_atlas_shaping_windows_test.go (one hidden, never-shown window at -32000: sprite pixels + DrawScene + DropImage; 6x150 texts then 400 in one frame; opening a window with all handles held), gpui/text_cache_bound_windows_test.go (parking without a window, re-shape after Relayout)
